title: End-to-End Hybrid CNOT + Pauli-X Frame + Newton-Hensel + R_Z Feedforward Constructive Receiver
claims: Combining mod-2 CNOT compression, Pauli-X sign-flip frame rectification, 2-adic Newton-Hensel matrix inversion V = U^{-1} mod 2^{t-1}, and stage-by-stage adaptive R_Z(-phi_known) phase feedforward achieves uniform distinguishing bias D_TV = gamma across all stages and secrets.
Exhaustive evaluation across all 64 secrets of Z_8^2 (t=4) and all 64 secrets of Z_4^3 (t=3) achieves 100% deterministic secret reconstruction across both syndrome sign branches.
